protocol.paired_seed_rule: for each training seed, DQN and Double DQN share the same seed, backend, stage budget, and evaluation protocol
protocol.resume_policy: fresh replay with learning-start rewarm; model, target, optimizer, counters, RNG, and provenance resume from checkpoint
